project_type: Python CLI tool for automated Naukri.com job applications, being refactored from Playwright-based to browser-use agent framework
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio, tests in tests/ directory, conftest.py has shared fixtures
verification_instructions: 1. Install deps with pip install -e '.[dev]', 2. Run pytest tests/ -v, 3. Verify imports work with python -c 'from naukri_apply.main import cli'
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Python 3.11.15 available. Virtual env at .venv/. No browser available for integration tests (headless only theoretical). Tests should mock browser-use Agent calls.
contribution_requirements: Keep CLI interface unchanged (click-based), keep CSV logger as-is, keep models.py compatible, update pyproject.toml dependencies, update config.example.yaml and .env.example, update README.md

key_patterns.cli: Click-based CLI in main.py with 'apply' and 'check-session' commands
key_patterns.config: Pydantic BaseModel (AppConfig) loaded from YAML + env vars via load_config()
key_patterns.models: Pydantic models for UserProfile, JobListing, ApplicationResult, enums for ApplyType/ApplicationStatus
key_patterns.logging: CSVLogger class writes real-time CSV rows with HEADERS constant
key_patterns.async_pattern: All handlers are async, entry via asyncio.run()
key_patterns.browser_use_api: browser-use v0.12.8 uses Agent(task=str, llm=ChatGroq(...), browser=BrowserSession(...)), BrowserProfile(user_data_dir=..., headless=...), ChatGroq(model=..., api_key=...) built-in. Agent.run() returns AgentHistoryList with .final_result()

directory_structure: src/naukri_apply/ - all source modules, tests/ - pytest tests, config.example.yaml/.env.example - config templates, pyproject.toml - build config
